reason: Canonical cursor parcel_77269 / HMLR INSPIRE 36834181 remains ineligible for Height Difference because BUILDING_PRESENT is still unproven. A materially different official Historic England NHLE source window was used: the Listed Building polygons layer is a real EPSG:27700 Polygon feature layer, released under OGL and carrying official List Entry Number, name, grade, NGR, easting and northing fields. The layer has no HMLR INSPIRE-ID field, and this batch does not perform the parcel-to-NHLE spatial intersection reserved for local OpenCode. Therefore no exact NHLE polygon/List Entry is attributed to parcel_77269, BUILDING_PRESENT is not advanced, and no DEM/LIDAR parcel evidence is accepted.
